messages:
jen: Quick check — change window tonight (23:00 UTC) is in place. We have an embeddings hotfix that fixes a 2-3s tail latency spike on long queries in EU. Requesting an exemption to deploy during the quiet window. Context: safe rollback available, small surface area (model-service + cache invalidation).

mike: Can you summarise risk + rollback steps in two bullets? Also what's the canary plan? :eyes:

jen: Risk: config change + model weights tweak (quantization param). Risk low, but touches embeddings-generation path so cost/latency impact.
Rollback: unpin and redeploy previous bundle v3.4.1 (takes ~4m), invalidate redis prefix `emb-v2:*` afterwards.
Canary: 5% traffic EU, monitor latency & error rate for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then 100%.

sre-lead: pinging deploy-bot for pin status and whether we can auto-unpin if metrics degrade. Also add a safety timer to auto-roll back after 20m failed canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Running preflight checks...
- pin status: model-service currently pinned to v3.4.1
- active canaries: none
- recent infra alerts: clear for last 2h
preflight OK. To proceed run: `/deploy model-service --image v3.4.2-embedhotfix --pin --canary 5%`

omar: Couple of notes: 1) Make sure the console alerting has the EU latency SLO on the canary dashboard. 2) If KV cache miss rate spikes >4% for 10m, that's an auto-fail.

kate: tagging app-observability to guarantee dashboards visible during canary: @app-obsv will you be on call 23:00-00:30 UTC?

jen: @kate yes I flipped the alert to high priority. We'll also add a synthetic every 30s hitting a typical long-seq embed to catch regressions.

mike: Agree with safety timer. Also please add a manual rollback channel pinned message with exact revert command and owner. I'll own rollback if triggered.

jen: Rollback command (pinned in ops channel):
```
/deploy model-service --image v3.4.1 --pin --force
redis-cli KEYS "emb-v2:*" | xargs -r redis-cli DEL
```
Owner: mike.

sre-lead: Approval: +1 from SRE for exemption under these conditions: 5% canary, 15m stable, auto-fail on error rate/kv-miss, manual rollback owner assigned.

omar: Security check: no new secrets or KMS changes. +1.

jen: Prod PM (kate) approves rolling hotfix during quiet window to avoid delaying customer impact. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Applying canary: 5% -> initiating. Canary ID: cb-655321. Watch metrics: `eu.embed.lat_p95`, `eu.embed.errors`, `eu.embed.kv_miss_rate`.

mike: Starting 23:02 UTC. I will monitor and will execute rollback if `eu.embed.lat_p95` > baseline + 2s for 3 consecutive 5m buckets.

jen: Thanks all — will post a short release note after canary completes. If anyone is not on the roster tonight, reply here now.

kate: I'm on until 00:30 UTC.

omar: I'll be reachable on phone if needed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cb-655321 progressed -> 5% healthy. Metrics: lat_p95 +0.3s, errors unchanged, kv_miss 0.9%. Continuing to 25% in 15m.

mike: 25% rollout starting now. Monitoring closely.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 25% steady at +0.4s p95, errors still flat, kv_miss 1.1%. Canary looks healthy. Advancing to 100% after 10m hold.

jen: Update filed to release-log: "v3.4.2-embedhotfix: reduced long-query tail latency in EU; safe rollback to v3.4.1; rolled out during quiet window with SRE approval."

mike: All done — 100% roll complete at 23:28 UTC. No anomalies. Closing exemption thread. :tada:
